name: track
description: Optional grouping for parallel clips on a named track (e.g. `<Track name="opacity">`). Tracks are a labeling/inspection convenience; they don't affect playback ordering.

props.name: name
props.description: Track name. Surfaced in dev tools and on registered ClipDescriptors.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Clips that share the track label.

examples.title: Grouped clips
examples.description: Two clips share an `opacity` track for clarity.
examples.code:
<Track name="opacity">
  <Clip target="#a" to={{ opacity: 1 }} />
  <Clip target="#b" to={{ opacity: 1 }} start={200} />
</Track>

ai.whenToUse: Use to label parallel clips that share an intent (`opacity`, `transform`) for readability and tooling.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't expect tracks to enforce playback exclusivity — they're metadata, not constraints.
commonMistakes: Treating tracks like timeline lanes — overlapping clips on the same track will still both play.
